**Preparation:** Complete each reading before the class period in which it is listed. All readings and assigned book excerpts are available on [Canvas](https://colostate.instructure.com/courses/230315/pages/readings). See the [course reading list](readings.qmd) for full references.

**Lecture numbers** identify the unit and meeting within that unit: Lecture 4.1 is the first meeting of Unit 4, and Lecture 4.2 is the second. The course introduction, recess, and final presentations are unnumbered.
